method: Read-only walk of ghidra/exports/cataclysm_gog_r3a (functions.csv, call_graph.csv, decompiled.c): alphabetical-module address clustering around applied HW1 names, call-graph neighbours of named functions, and line-by-line body comparison with reference/HomeworldSDL/src/Game/*.c (constants, struct strides, callee sequence, string literals). Inlined HW1 helpers are noted in evidence.

proposals.name: clipViewclipLine
proposals.evidence: Clipper.c block after Clamp.c; (vectors,i,j) 6-plane homogeneous clip, Free=2 start, returns 0 when both outside; only caller clipLineToScreen 0x435bd0

proposals.name: clipTransformPoints
proposals.evidence: (n,vObj,vEye,m) loop vEye=m*vObj with m[0],m[4],m[8],m[12] pattern, stride 16; called by clipPointToScreen/BBox/Line helpers

proposals.name: clipProjectPoints
proposals.evidence: 7 params (n,vEye,vClip,clipmask,ormask,andmask,m); inlined clipIsPerspective test m[11]==-1 m[15]==0, two loops computing clip masks

proposals.name: clipViewportMap
proposals.evidence: (n,vClip,clipmask,vWin,viewportS,viewportT,force); w==0 -> zero, else 1/w*s+t, stride 4->3 floats, two branches on clipmask&&!force

proposals.name: clipPointToScreenWithMatrices
